name.value: Green Acres Lakeside Resort Salt Spring Island

description.value: Green Acres Lakeside Resort is a cabin-and-chalet resort founded in 1945 on the north shores of St. Mary Lake, offering self-contained units with full kitchens, wood stoves, and private decks. Guests have free use of canoes, kayaks, paddleboards, and rowboats from a private beach and floating docks. The resort sits a 10-minute drive from the town of Ganges, near hiking trails, mountain biking, and the famous Salt Spring Saturday Market.

address.value: 241 Langs Rd, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 1N3

raw_osm.name: Green Acres Lakeside Resort Salt Spring Island

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms the resort's identity, address, phone, and email match the OSM tags. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed via 'high speed internet throughout' and a per-cabin 'Wifi available in every accommodation' listing. No mention of bike-specific storage, laundry, tools, or e-bike charging appears anywhere on the site, so those remain null. The FAQ mentions mountain biking as a guest highlight but provides no cyclist-service infrastructure detail.
concerns: OSM name appends 'Salt Spring Island' as part of the business name; the website uses 'Green Acres Lakeside Resort' and 'Green Acres Resort' as the actual trading names. Not a material discrepancy but worth noting.
OSM community field is set to 'Chemainus' but the resort is located on Salt Spring Island — likely an OSM administrative area tagging issue.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating lakeside resort open year-round with active online booking; confirmed address, phone, and website all match OSM.
